notes: Built the fleet keeper: tools/fleet-keeper.sh (a bash loop, not an engine change — src/managent/main.zig is serial-held by T485/T486/T487), tools/fleet-cooldown.sh (on|off|status for the graceful-stop flag file), tools/regression-fleet-keeper.sh (controls, wired into zig build test), and the DFLEET duty row in docs/infra/duties.md with its landmark-gate exemption noted. The keeper reads bin/managent status --json every FLEET_INTERVAL seconds (default 10), honours a configurable FLEET_CAP (default 5, operator ruling 2026-08-19), and fires bin/dispatch <id> <model> for the oldest-by-added eligible T-id task (status dispatchable, not a duty, needs all done, exactly one bundle); model from the row's stored model else FLEET_DEFAULT_MODEL (default glm-5.2). Cooldown is a file (untracked/fleet-keeper.cooldown); fail-safe on the cool side — an unreadable cooldown dir is treated as cooldown-set (dead-man's switch). It never dispatches duty rows or non-T seats (ORCHA-*, STANDING-*); bin/dispatch's own T\d+ guard is inherited. TDD: the two seeded arms (fire-oldest-until-cap, cooldown-logs-nothing) and the four null arms (empty, at-cap, unmet-need, seat+duty) were written and seen red before the keeper existed, then went green. Ordering caveat: bin/managent status --json omits `added`, so the keeper resolves it per eligible row via `managent show <id>` (the public CLI, not the store schema — T485-T487 may reshape the store). Acceptance: the scratch regression is all green; a live smoke on the real queue was run with cooldown SET only (keeper observes in_progress=1, fires nothing, logs 'cooldown flag set — no new dispatches') — the cooldown-clear live-fire half is deferred to the Orchestrator's launch decision per the brief's own rule ('the Orchestrator decides when to launch it'), so no real worker was dispatched unsolicited and no live kanban row was mutated. The live keeper is NOT left running at close. Inbox loop (T352): polled bin/managent inbox T496 --ack at task open, after wiring, and before done — empty throughout (no D0NN directives). No register change (claims: []).
